frost_troll.desc: Frost troll (1.6x; gate foe at 2x): ice-blue hide, ragged tunic, belted rag trousers, tusks, throws ice chunks / swings an ice club.

ice_golem.desc: Ice golem (1.5x): translucent ice blocks round a glowing rune heart.

avalanche_golem.desc: Avalanche golem (1.8x): a snow-capped boulder that unfolds into a golem; attack = rolls as a ball.

rime_berserker.desc: Rime Berserker (elite, 1.8x): fur over a belted tunic, belted trousers, two ice axes, wild braids.
